feedTitle: Isle of Man 5 day weather forecast

items.title: 5 day forecast updated as of 30 May 2026 6:30am
items.description:
##Today##

Dry with bright or sunny intervals at first, risk of low cloud and coastal mist through the morning. Patchy rain or drizzle developing from mid-afternoon petering out later in the day. Increased risk of low cloud and coastal mist in the evening and overnight.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 12°C and max. air temperature 18°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

1-3


##Wind Speed##

15


##Wind Direction##

SW


##Wind##

S or SW 10-15, increasing 15-20 late afternoon/ early evening, occasionally 20-25 in places later in the evening, veering W or SW 10-15 overnight.


##Visibility##

Good, occasional moderate or poor in rain, drizzle or in coastal mist later. Hill fog developing and lowering.


##Comments##

Occasional strong winds later.


##Tomorrow##

Mostly dry with only isolated showers but still some bright/ sunny intervals.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 12°C and max. air temperature 17°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

0-2


##Wind Speed##

15


##Wind Direction##

SW


##Wind##

SW 15-20, backing 10-15 later, decreasing 5-10 overnight.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate later. Hill fog at night.


##Comments##

Nil.


##Monday, 1 June 2026##

Cloudy with outbreaks of rain developing at first, soon clearing to give a drier interlude for a time. Further rain following in the evening.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 12°C and max. air temperature 16°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

3-10


##Wind Speed##

12


##Wind Direction##

SW


##Wind##

S or SW 10-15.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain. Hill fog.


##Comments##

Nil.


##Tuesday, 2 June 2026##

Sunny intervals and isolated showers at first, these showers becoming more frequent later in the day.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 11°C and max. air temperature 17°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

0-4


##Wind Speed##

15


##Wind Direction##

SW


##Wind##

S or SW 10-15, soon veering W or NW 15-20, backing S or SW 10-15 later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in showers. Occasional hill fog.


##Comments##

Nil


##Wednesday, 3 June 2026##

Mostly dry and bright at first, rain arriving through the afternoon, clearing to scattered showers later in the day, these possibly heavy in places.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 10°C and max. air temperature 15°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

2-7


##Wind Speed##

18


##Wind Direction##

SW


##Wind##

W or SW 10-15, soon backing S or SW 15-20 occasionally 25 in places, increasing SW 20-25 occasionally 30 later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain or showers. Hill fog developing.


##Comments##

Strong wind developing.
